SELECT u.id, u.nickname, u.avatar, COALESCE(cs.credit_score, 100) AS credit_score, COALESCE(cs.deal_count, 0) AS deal_count, COALESCE(cs.avg_rating, 0) AS avg_rating, COALESCE(cs.good_review_rate, 0) AS good_review_rate FROM `user` u LEFT JOIN user_credit_summary cs ON cs.user_id = u.id WHERE u.id = #{sellerId} LIMIT 1

mapper.update: UPDATE product SET category_id = #{categoryId}, title = #{title}, description = #{description}, price = #{price}, stock = #{stock}, item_condition = #{itemCondition}, campus = #{campus}, trade_place = #{tradePlace}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND seller_id = #{sellerId} AND version = #{version} AND status IN (0, 2, 4) AND deleted = 0
UPDATE product SET status = 1, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND seller_id = #{sellerId} AND status IN (0, 2, 4) AND stock > 0 AND deleted = 0
UPDATE product SET status = 0, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND seller_id = #{sellerId} AND status = 1 AND deleted = 0
UPDATE product SET status = 4, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND seller_id = #{sellerId} AND status IN (3, 5) AND deleted = 0

UPDATE product SET status = CASE WHEN status = 5 AND stock + #{delta} > 0 THEN 3 ELSE status END, stock = stock + #{delta}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND seller_id = #{sellerId} AND status IN (3, 5) AND stock + #{delta} >= 1 AND deleted = 0

UPDATE product SET status = CASE WHEN stock - #{quantity} = 0 THEN 5 ELSE status END, stock = stock - #{quantity}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 3 AND stock >= #{quantity} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE product SET stock = stock + #{quantity}, status = CASE WHEN status = 5 THEN 3 ELSE status END, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE product SET status = #{targetStatus}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1 AND deleted = 0
